methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from official vendor pricing/product pages where possible (Norton, Avast, Bitdefender, Comodo). Where official pages returned JS-only renders, 403/504 errors, or geo-redirected to non-USD regions (McAfee timed out repeatedly; Kaspersky www.kaspersky.com redirects to kaspersky.de; ESET store renders prices client-side only; Malwarebytes pricing is JS-rendered with placeholders), pricing was sourced from security.org antivirus review pages (a reputable, annually-updated comparison site) and cross-checked against official product pages for plan structure. All monthlyUsd figures represent the annualized monthly rate (annual price / 12) for plans billed annually. Renewal/regular prices used where both intro and renewal prices were found; first-year intro prices noted in plan notes. accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources.
